scope: Bounded Python-int p-1 follow-up: bit-capped chunks, even-gap recurrence and one exact +/- trace BSGS executor. No ECM/Lucas/native-backend/allocation changes.
inputs: p43_size_corpus.json: screen fixtures at 20/50/100 digits; fresh confirmation comes from a6_followup_corpus.json generated by build_a6_followup_corpus.py with seed 2026100919 and verified Pocklington certificates before any timing, without engine/outcome filtering

chunk_screen.selection: Among bits256/bits512/bits1024/recurrence64 choose at most one arithmetic challenger by greatest geometric-mean whole-API gain versus control64 across all six screen cells, provided every cell has positive median gain and the aggregate paired 95% bootstrap lower bound exceeds zero. Otherwise retain control64. Do not combine separately screened changes or retune caps.

paired_screen.selection: Use the frozen chunk-screen selected arithmetic configuration for all paired arms. Choose at most one wheel by geometric-mean gain across all six screen cells, requiring every median gain positive and aggregate paired 95% bootstrap lower bound above zero. If no wheel qualifies generally, carry at most one scoped wheel with positive medians in all three 11000/100000 screen classes and a positive aggregate paired 95% lower bound at that bound; otherwise retain unpaired execution. Record the scope before confirmation. Coverage must be identical as a union of eligible prime relations up to multiplication by units; no relocation or square-exponent extension.

confirmation.selection: Freeze selected configuration IDs in a versioned selection manifest before opening confirmation timings. Require zero correctness failures, all nine median gains positive versus control64 for general promotion of a challenger, positive per-class aggregate paired 95% bootstrap intervals and relative IQR below 15%. Extend all arms together to 27 then 63 samples if uncertain/unstable; retain after 63 if inconclusive. A predeclared larger-bound wheel may qualify for scoped adoption only when all three fresh size-class medians improve and its per-bound aggregate paired 95% interval excludes zero; report all other classes and keep automatic defaults unchanged. No universal minimum percentage. Report losses and construction/recovery/storage/resume costs.

legacy_hook_check: Measure the current default-config action hook against the frozen control64, separately from optimization selection; verify byte-canonical arithmetic/work and legacy checkpoint compatibility. Report any sustained regression.

continuation.inputs: all fresh a6_followup_corpus.json fixtures at 20/50/100 digits
continuation.selection: Report selected challenger and retained control separately; count reconstruction, final serialization, storage and cumulative resources. No ladder/allocation promotion from constructed cases.

portfolio.bridge: Benchmark-only stage-job adapter with identical base/seed/assignment and parent budget/context; production portfolio code and serialized formats untouched.
portfolio.selection: Report completion and split rates, total CPU and marginal completion per added CPU-second, with all result reconstructions validated. At most a 5-percentage-point completion regression; this small biased cohort cannot justify general allocation promotion.

correctness: Direct small powers and independent exhaustive prime coverage, complete LCM-ratio tests, prime-power endpoints, stage-two-only factors, same-pair and cross-pair saturation, nonunits, atomic refusal, cancellation, all-boundary canonical resume, resigned corrupt state, cumulative allowances and legacy checkpoint compatibility
exclusions: Compiled cross-input plans and polynomial/chirp-z are conditional later work. No threshold/bound/curve-count changes; no merge. Cold startup and instrumented profiling are separate. Accepted timing and heavy checks require the queued exclusive window.
